這集，主持姐姐和Choco分享德國一位圓號演奏家的勵志故事。雖然天生沒有雙臂，他卻自小已立志要練好圓號，最終更排除身邊人的勸阻，成功以腳代手吹奏圓號。「My Little Show」舞台，江心悠、岑家亮用圓號與鍵琴合奏輕快樂章。兩人在訪問中提到，會注意節奏和溝通，避免於合奏時出錯。此外，主持們還會帶來一項中學生智能創意比賽的資訊。
小丸子打電話找野口，誰知接電話的是富士男，變成小丸子要替富士男想白色情人節該送什麼禮物。小丸子家裡屋頂被風吹壞，前來的維修師傅叫宮園，帶著結他和狗的他意想不到的親切風趣，更會唱歌。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
太陽每天散發著光和熱，令地球出現白日和黑晚。太陽似乎遙不可及，但又與我們的生活息息相關，今集節目中，太陽所隱藏的秘密即將揭曉！我們平時看到的太陽光到底是白色還是黃色？七色彩虹是如何產生的？為甚麼雨後容易見到彩虹？太陽風又是甚麼？對地球有怎樣的影響？臭氧層有何作用？出現臭氧洞對人類有甚麼危害？Master Joe和科學老師透過多個實驗，解開一連串關於太陽的奧秘！
胖虎家中的暖爐壞了。因為不甘心只有自己捱凍，於是叫了大雄和小夫出來陪他捱凍。大雄被媽媽拿來與別人的孩子比較，因此而不開心。之後，大雄突然想到找一個弟弟來，證明自己也能做一個好哥哥。

《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
太陽每天散發著光和熱，令地球出現白日和黑晚。太陽似乎遙不可及，但又與我們的生活息息相關，今集節目中，太陽所隱藏的秘密即將揭曉！我們平時看到的太陽光到底是白色還是黃色？七色彩虹是如何產生的？為甚麼雨後容易見到彩虹？太陽風又是甚麼？對地球有怎樣的影響？臭氧層有何作用？出現臭氧洞對人類有甚麼危害？Master Joe和科學老師透過多個實驗，解開一連串關於太陽的奧秘！
胖虎家中的暖爐壞了。因為不甘心只有自己捱凍，於是叫了大雄和小夫出來陪他捱凍。大雄被媽媽拿來與別人的孩子比較，因此而不開心。之後，大雄突然想到找一個弟弟來，證明自己也能做一個好哥哥。

epg.programme_title_tc: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊 #1 [粵/普]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。
這集，主持姐姐和Choco分享德國一位圓號演奏家的勵志故事。雖然天生沒有雙臂，他卻自小已立志要練好圓號，最終更排除身邊人的勸阻，成功以腳代手吹奏圓號。「My Little Show」舞台，江心悠、岑家亮用圓號與鍵琴合奏輕快樂章。兩人在訪問中提到，會注意節奏和溝通，避免於合奏時出錯。此外，主持們還會帶來一項中學生智能創意比賽的資訊。

「Kids’ Notes」繼續有兒童畫家帶來更多作品，除了使用平板電腦及顏料作畫外，原來用石頭、雞蛋殼、報紙等生活上接觸到的物品都可「拼砌」出畫作。藝術家母親還提到女兒曾「採集」家中的頭髮去為火柴人作品增添細節？小畫家也會展示如何運用科技，為實體的畫作注入動畫和音樂的元素。要完成動畫創作雖然要衝破不少困難，但只要多作嘗試，過程就會越來越簡易。眾多以蛇為主題的作品之中，哪條「蛇」最得這位小畫家喜愛？
麵包店開張拉彩球，小丸子看見很喜歡，也想嚐嚐拉彩球滋味，於是與爺爺一起買材料製作。小丸子遇到一位經常做運動的大姐姐，得知對方來自東京，更是一名摔角手，大姐姐教她做事需要有拚勁。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

銀河由無數排列密集的恆星組成，太陽系就位於銀河系中，太陽系有8大行星，這些行星除了圍繞太陽公轉，亦都各自以一定的傾斜角度繞軸轉動。它們各有甚麼特色？哪顆行星最大？哪顆最熱？木星上的大紅點又是甚麼？兩位AI帶大家尋求答案！當月球、地球和太陽運行至連成一條直線時，站在地球上的我們就能看到太陽被部份或者整個月球遮蓋，最後出現一段時間的黑暗，這種自然現象就是「日食」。但有些星體並不會出現日食，這是為甚麼？
多啦美難得買到一直想吃的頂級蜜瓜包，卻被多啦Ａ夢擅自吃了。兄妹二人因此吵架。天氣寒冷，大雄不想出外，只想睡覺，還責怪地球的日間時間太長。見此，多啦Ａ夢用法寶幫大雄塑造一個理想的星球。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

「Kids’ Notes」繼續有兒童畫家帶來更多作品，除了使用平板電腦及顏料作畫外，原來用石頭、雞蛋殼、報紙等生活上接觸到的物品都可「拼砌」出畫作。藝術家母親還提到女兒曾「採集」家中的頭髮去為火柴人作品增添細節？小畫家也會展示如何運用科技，為實體的畫作注入動畫和音樂的元素。要完成動畫創作雖然要衝破不少困難，但只要多作嘗試，過程就會越來越簡易。眾多以蛇為主題的作品之中，哪條「蛇」最得這位小畫家喜愛？
麵包店開張拉彩球，小丸子看見很喜歡，也想嚐嚐拉彩球滋味，於是與爺爺一起買材料製作。小丸子遇到一位經常做運動的大姐姐，得知對方來自東京，更是一名摔角手，大姐姐教她做事需要有拚勁。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

銀河由無數排列密集的恆星組成，太陽系就位於銀河系中，太陽系有8大行星，這些行星除了圍繞太陽公轉，亦都各自以一定的傾斜角度繞軸轉動。它們各有甚麼特色？哪顆行星最大？哪顆最熱？木星上的大紅點又是甚麼？兩位AI帶大家尋求答案！當月球、地球和太陽運行至連成一條直線時，站在地球上的我們就能看到太陽被部份或者整個月球遮蓋，最後出現一段時間的黑暗，這種自然現象就是「日食」。但有些星體並不會出現日食，這是為甚麼？
多啦美難得買到一直想吃的頂級蜜瓜包，卻被多啦Ａ夢擅自吃了。兄妹二人因此吵架。天氣寒冷，大雄不想出外，只想睡覺，還責怪地球的日間時間太長。見此，多啦Ａ夢用法寶幫大雄塑造一個理想的星球。

今集「芭蕾天地」環節，首先送上著名芭蕾舞劇《胡桃夾子》的精采片段，之後導師會帶領一班學員示範一段劇中的舞步。香港芭蕾舞團藝術總監John Meehan受訪，提及他對男舞蹈員的看法。而「芭蕾禮儀教室」會講解欣賞芭蕾舞劇的禮儀。另外，攝影藝術家尹子聰會教小朋友一些攝影技巧。在「向攝影出發」中，他會講解拍攝黑白照和彩色照的手法；還帶領小朋友到香港仔進行戶外攝影，讓他們運用所學的技巧，拍出屬於個人的作品。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
正式登台在即，但兩人依然練習不多，檸檬為此感到擔憂，更打扮成米露琪的樣子去找她。檸檬到米露琪家裡的蔬果店幫忙，後者用雜菜湯作出比喻，指練習太多只會令兩人過度磨合，埋沒各自各的個性。

節目組讓小朋友寫兩封信，一封是給或將誕生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遺書。眾人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，對離世之事傷感。百日宴和喪禮，是生與死的兩樁人生大事，在籌辦過程中卻有不少相似的地方；洪永城帶孩子們作進一步認識。有男生親自體驗躺棺木、遺體化妝，感受如何？及後他為參加百日宴變妝，妝容會有甚麼不同？再探索二者的場地佈置，小朋友對選擇棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也會嘗試為百日宴製作氣球橋，及為喪禮預備棺面花。
一男一女本地小朋友，分別與一位外籍小孩背對背坐下。大家只透過說話認識對方，對於這種交友模式，眾人感受如何？主持洪永城講出不同的地方，讓孩子們說出第一印象，原來不少小朋友都覺得日本人有禮貌。永城接着帶兩位港孩家訪俄羅斯小朋友，並一同享用俄式家常菜，吃後有甚麼感想？餐後，眾位小朋友換上俄國的節慶服飾，隨俄裔男士體驗當地傳統舞蹈。大家及後還會試玩俄國民間的孩童遊戲，這是一款拋擲木棒的競技，玩法怎樣？

今集「芭蕾天地」環節，首先送上著名芭蕾舞劇《胡桃夾子》的精采片段，之後導師會帶領一班學員示範一段劇中的舞步。香港芭蕾舞團藝術總監John Meehan受訪，提及他對男舞蹈員的看法。而「芭蕾禮儀教室」會講解欣賞芭蕾舞劇的禮儀。另外，攝影藝術家尹子聰會教小朋友一些攝影技巧。在「向攝影出發」中，他會講解拍攝黑白照和彩色照的手法；還帶領小朋友到香港仔進行戶外攝影，讓他們運用所學的技巧，拍出屬於個人的作品。

一男一女本地小朋友，分別與一位外籍小孩背對背坐下。大家只透過說話認識對方，對於這種交友模式，眾人感受如何？主持洪永城講出不同的地方，讓孩子們說出第一印象，原來不少小朋友都覺得日本人有禮貌。永城接着帶兩位港孩家訪俄羅斯小朋友，並一同享用俄式家常菜，吃後有甚麼感想？餐後，眾位小朋友換上俄國的節慶服飾，隨俄裔男士體驗當地傳統舞蹈。大家及後還會試玩俄國民間的孩童遊戲，這是一款拋擲木棒的競技，玩法怎樣？

蚌蚌公主出任廠長主持大局，「零食廠」這次上演三對三的比拼。在考驗聆聽能力與反應的「廠長話」遊戲，眾人都表現出色。為了增加難度，蚌蚌公主要求小兵們同時做出兩個動作，大家可會應付得來？「溶化之橋」關卡，眼見兩位隊友分別運送四個與三個雪糕球都輕鬆抵達終點，最後登場的曲奇女兵決意挑戰五個雪糕球，能否安全送達？
小丸子希望早一步享受春天，於是聽從中野的建議，去河津町看在冬天綻放的河津櫻。媽媽為大家買了新恤衫，但爸爸更愛熟悉的舊恤衫。爺爺在外不慎摔倒，但想到自己穿著殘舊內褲，堅決拒絕就醫。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
星星是白色的嗎？每顆恆星都有其壽命，太陽會不會也有「死亡」的一天？而宇宙黑洞又是甚麼？恆星的壽命取決於質量大小和核心的燃燒程度，由一百萬年到幾百億年不等。其質量越大，熱核反應就會進行得越激烈！當恆星到了晚年，星體就會逐漸膨脹，並且發出紅色的光，變成「紅巨星」。太陽也是一顆恆星，會不會也變成「紅巨星」？宇宙中的黑洞體積小，密度大，擁有巨大的吸引力，連速度最快的光都難以穿過，它到底是甚麼神秘天體？
叔叔送了一套圖鑑給大雄。媽媽要大雄寫道謝信給叔叔，但大雄卻無法寫出得體的信。大雄家中的暖爐壞了。多啦A夢使用「呼喚精靈手鈪」召喚出火的精靈來取暖。但火的精靈卻失控，想把周圍的物品燒掉。

一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

曲奇小兵團於上回做出了十二個雪糕球的成績，輪到薯片小兵團的三位成員上陣。每人都要求挑戰五個雪糕球，最終都穩定、快捷地運送到終點，輕鬆以總數十五個雪糕球壓倒對手，取得健康零食秘笈。這集拼砌漢堡包遊戲，因為每邊都有三個小兵，令拼砌的速度加快了，比賽過程更加刺激！最終回合，薯片小兵團掉轉了番茄與雞蛋的次序，就此慢了一步完成，更痛失最後一卷健康零食秘笈。
豬太郎幫老婆婆過馬路，收到巧克力作為回禮，誰知被同學誤以為是情人節巧克力，掀起一場風波。學校即將舉行馬拉松比賽，令小丸子心情鬱結，爺爺受到電視節目啟發，決定自告奮勇擔任其教練。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
為甚麼電能令電器運作？將電源、導線和電子元件連接成一條路徑，叫做電路。電源會向電子輸出能量，電子就會由電源的負極，沿著導線流向正極，形成電子流。如果電子可以順利通過所有元件，形成一個完整的循環，就會組成閉合電路，令各元件正常工作。但是，電流並非任何物質都能通過，哪些物質是可通過電流的導電體，哪些是不能通過電流的絕緣體？而電還能產生強大的磁力，「磁化」周圍的一些物質，「磁化」是怎樣的過程？
一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

曲奇小兵團於上回做出了十二個雪糕球的成績，輪到薯片小兵團的三位成員上陣。每人都要求挑戰五個雪糕球，最終都穩定、快捷地運送到終點，輕鬆以總數十五個雪糕球壓倒對手，取得健康零食秘笈。這集拼砌漢堡包遊戲，因為每邊都有三個小兵，令拼砌的速度加快了，比賽過程更加刺激！最終回合，薯片小兵團掉轉了番茄與雞蛋的次序，就此慢了一步完成，更痛失最後一卷健康零食秘笈。
豬太郎幫老婆婆過馬路，收到巧克力作為回禮，誰知被同學誤以為是情人節巧克力，掀起一場風波。學校即將舉行馬拉松比賽，令小丸子心情鬱結，爺爺受到電視節目啟發，決定自告奮勇擔任其教練。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
為甚麼電能令電器運作？將電源、導線和電子元件連接成一條路徑，叫做電路。電源會向電子輸出能量，電子就會由電源的負極，沿著導線流向正極，形成電子流。如果電子可以順利通過所有元件，形成一個完整的循環，就會組成閉合電路，令各元件正常工作。但是，電流並非任何物質都能通過，哪些物質是可通過電流的導電體，哪些是不能通過電流的絕緣體？而電還能產生強大的磁力，「磁化」周圍的一些物質，「磁化」是怎樣的過程？
一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

這集「5-Minute Workout」，請來兒童體適能教練馬家衡(斑馬哥哥)指導大、小朋友以汽球作輔助，鍛練身體的協調能力。斑馬哥哥讓大家用手掌、手指、膝蓋等不同身體部位，把汽球向上推，保持汽球不可掉落地上。此外，也可由家長發施號令，要求小朋友以指定的身體部位推汽球，共創親子快樂時光。不過，大家做運動時要留意四周狀況，也應避免於狹窄的環境內訓練，免生意外。

《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
浮力與物體密度和液體密度息息相關，密度是物體在固定的體積內所含的質量，相同體積的物體，所含的質量越多，密度就越大，而且密度較低的物質會浮在密度較高的物質上面，而物體本身的密度會影響它在液體中的浮沉。液體的密度對浮力亦有影響。將兩隻雞蛋分別放入清水和鹽水中，清水中的雞蛋會下沉，鹽水中的卻會浮起，是因為在相同體積下，鹽水的密度比水大，因此浮力就比水大，足以令雞蛋浮起。那麼潛水艇又為甚麼可以浮沉自如？
大雄遇上正在送貨的胖虎。胖虎見到大雄，便把全部貨品塞了給大雄，要大雄替他送貨。大雄聽到父母說要替他找補習老師，情急之下承諾會努力改善成績。但是大雄三分鐘熱度，更想出了一個鬼主意。

這集「5-Minute Workout」，請來兒童體適能教練馬家衡(斑馬哥哥)指導大、小朋友以汽球作輔助，鍛練身體的協調能力。斑馬哥哥讓大家用手掌、手指、膝蓋等不同身體部位，把汽球向上推，保持汽球不可掉落地上。此外，也可由家長發施號令，要求小朋友以指定的身體部位推汽球，共創親子快樂時光。不過，大家做運動時要留意四周狀況，也應避免於狹窄的環境內訓練，免生意外。
小丸子發現，扮猩猩的動作可以令到媽媽笑，甚至可令正在罵人的媽媽息怒。小丸子與同學們在溜冰場遇到一個目中無人的男孩。之後在大家的推波助瀾之下，藤木與那個男孩約定了進行溜冰對賽。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
浮力與物體密度和液體密度息息相關，密度是物體在固定的體積內所含的質量，相同體積的物體，所含的質量越多，密度就越大，而且密度較低的物質會浮在密度較高的物質上面，而物體本身的密度會影響它在液體中的浮沉。液體的密度對浮力亦有影響。將兩隻雞蛋分別放入清水和鹽水中，清水中的雞蛋會下沉，鹽水中的卻會浮起，是因為在相同體積下，鹽水的密度比水大，因此浮力就比水大，足以令雞蛋浮起。那麼潛水艇又為甚麼可以浮沉自如？
大雄遇上正在送貨的胖虎。胖虎見到大雄，便把全部貨品塞了給大雄，要大雄替他送貨。大雄聽到父母說要替他找補習老師，情急之下承諾會努力改善成績。但是大雄三分鐘熱度，更想出了一個鬼主意。

小丸子發現，扮猩猩的動作可以令到媽媽笑，甚至可令正在罵人的媽媽息怒。小丸子與同學們在溜冰場遇到一個目中無人的男孩。之後在大家的推波助瀾之下，藤木與那個男孩約定了進行溜冰對賽。

持續的大雨令所有櫻花的花瓣，幾乎都被雨水打掉。大雄的爸爸媽媽原本期待的賞花，看來無法如願。大雄的班中來了個插班生。大家樂於與插班生交換個人簡介。但自問一無是處的大雄，愁著如何寫個人簡介。

天虹國主帥蓋天鴻向海棠國下戰書，海棠公主遂往芙蓉國欲游說聯盟抵抗，卻被鴻截獲，鴻一念之仁放走她。海棠國得援兵相助，鴻兵敗如山倒被擒。海棠公主不忍恩將仇報，求國王放過鴻。其後鴻更憑玉珮認回親妹芙蓉公主。
李文傑將與表妹丁蕙芬結婚，但傑不慎弄歪了嘴，傑父怕芬嫌棄傑，著傑姐文慧暫冒充傑。慧對芬冷淡，讓芬誤會。莊仲才因與女友慧失聯多時，喬裝女傭入李家查探，終真相大白，芬卻不滿摑傑，竟讓傑回復原貌，皆大歡喜。

epg.programme_title_tc: 女攝青鬼乞米養孤兒大結局
epg.programme_title_en: Spirit Killer Go Begging for an Orphan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）程麗霜向夫秦雪郎哭訴遇害經過，並著雪隱瞞小英身份。雪兄嫂王月嬌誕下兒子後，雪與英更為受辱。後嬌驚悉英的身世，欲毒害他，幸霜及時相救，並讓嬌重演害她慘死的經過。嬌臨終前向雪懺悔，霜終含笑離去。

梅海玲和宋大明訂下白頭之約，可惜此時玲弟急病入院，明為助玲籌錢，不惜借貴利，但無力償還。玲得悉後，為替明還債無奈答應下嫁老翁古壽南，卻讓明誤會玲貪慕虛榮。南於新婚夜，得悉玲委身下嫁，遂贈金錢讓她與明結婚，可惜明已離去。轉眼二十年，明出人頭地回來，玲巧合地到明家當女傭，二人重逢，明出言侮辱玲，更趕她離開。玲傷心不已，適時重回故地的明友蘇炳文見狀，向明說出真相。明即找玲認錯，這對白頭情侶終可再續前緣。
呂淑莊與金源、盧連、盧筱雯偶然得到兩條鎖匙及一張地圖，而這些東西乃歹徒陶力與金源的叔父爭奪的目標，眾人因此捲進危機之中。淑莊被陶力騙至鬼屋後，誤以為金源叔父遭殺害。陶力威脅金源等人交出鎖匙並囚禁他們。金源等人逃脫卻發現其叔父未死，原來他與金源的父親、陶力皆為大賊，因盜取鑽石後發生內鬨，金父意外死去。最後陶力奪去鑽石，金源等人追至其巢穴，與他展開惡鬥。危急之際，警方及時趕至，淑莊等人平安無恙。
李文傑將與表妹丁蕙芬結婚，但傑不慎弄歪了嘴，傑父怕芬嫌棄傑，著傑姐文慧暫冒充傑。慧對芬冷淡，讓芬誤會。莊仲才因與女友慧失聯多時，喬裝女傭入李家查探，終真相大白，芬卻不滿摑傑，竟讓傑回復原貌，皆大歡喜。

崔夫人本答應將女兒鶯鶯許配予書生張君瑞，但她反口悔婚，幸小侍女紅娘為他們牽引紅線，瑞與鶯私訂終身。瑞上京赴考高中狀元。鶯的表兄與鶯早有婚約，他向鶯催婚，並騙說瑞已另娶，幸瑞回來道出真相，與鶯終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_en: What's Between a Man & a Ghost
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫銀花與呂天和相戀，但花被迫嫁給孫若崇為妾，後被崇妻陳氏誣衊與和有姦情。花誕下紹宗後，被推下山崖，幸大難不死，化身為攝青鬼報仇。多年後，和終與花重逢，時宗為捕攝青鬼而向花開槍，因而揭發前事，真相大白。
李克勝與白玉梅本指腹為婚，但兩人都擔心對方貌醜，勝找欠債的金福代為拜堂，梅亦找婢女梅月白代嫁。福、白本是未婚夫妻，兩人均誤會對方負情而與別人成親，幸最終誤會解開，福與白成為眷屬，勝與梅亦結成佳偶。
（續上集）杜諾遭暗算掉下懸崖，幸大難不死，更遇上高人，獲傳授武功。原來暗算杜諾的蒙面人正是邵振文，他竟是杜諾殺父仇人五雷神君的徒弟，兩人狼狽為奸。杜諾得小冥女等人之助，最終成功手刃神君師徒，大仇得報。

天朝尚書周公智密謀造反，向皇帝下蠱毒。陳秋荷為救皇帝，往取天蛇膽作藥引，卻中蛇毒，幸獲金蛇公主相救。烏蘭國興兵侵犯，荷出征抗敵，與金蛇公主交鋒。為平息干戈，智被斬首，兩國修好，荷與金蛇公主亦締結良緣。
作家黃志民自與妻子李芳離婚後，與女兒小玉相依為命。當年原來何彪使計讓芳誤會民移情別戀，再騙芳嫁給他以得其金錢做非法勾當。其後彪更綁架玉向芳索錢，民得知後與芳爭執，民錯手開槍。玉以為芳被殺，替父認罪……
蔡伯龍的鏢局押送鏢銀遭女賊截劫，並留下飛刀，讓龍回想因誤信沖天炮而趕走其妻陳韻霜。女賊蔡無雙提出與龍比武，惜不敵，霜便告知龍雙乃其親女，龍求霜原諒遭拒，時炮找雙報仇，龍出手相助，霜感動，一家破鏡重圓。
李靖夫人懷胎多年才誕下哪吒，吒異於常人。其後吒到處生事惹下大禍，玉帝降罪李家，吒一死以謝罪。吒回魂著母為其建廟，好讓他受香火以還陽，惜靖氣子不肖將廟燒掉，幸太乙真人助吒還陽。李夫人勸吒改過，與父和好。
沈仲祺愛上身份神秘、外號「玫瑰夫人」的霍愛珠，然而祺父沈雄原來乃霍家仇人，當年珠父母遭雄慘害。珠與父永森密謀報仇，珠假意嫁祺以引雄現身，卻被雄識破其計劃，反施計欲殺害森父女，幸祺趕至，終化解兩家仇怨。
作家黃志民自與妻子李芳離婚後，與女兒小玉相依為命。當年原來何彪使計讓芳誤會民移情別戀，再騙芳嫁給他以得其金錢做非法勾當。其後彪更綁架玉向芳索錢，民得知後與芳爭執，民錯手開槍。玉以為芳被殺，替父認罪……

蔡伯龍的鏢局押送鏢銀遭女賊截劫，並留下飛刀，讓龍回想因誤信沖天炮而趕走其妻陳韻霜。女賊蔡無雙提出與龍比武，惜不敵，霜便告知龍雙乃其親女，龍求霜原諒遭拒，時炮找雙報仇，龍出手相助，霜感動，一家破鏡重圓。

epg.programme_title_en: Fate of My Poor Daughter-in-Law, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葉振雄走私被捕入獄，雄妻因操勞致失明。十年後，雄子仲華娶青梅竹馬的張玉梅為妻，時戰亂旱災，幸梅拾得金銀珠寶，一家生活轉好。此時雄潦倒歸來，華不認父，還納梅的表姐丁月芳為妾。梅屢遭芳欺凌，決投河自盡……
阿昌得夢娜相助解困，並與眾房客為娜任職的歌廳裝修，但眾人將歌廳佈置與靈堂相若而被辭退。昌當上殯儀經紀，卻把歌廳老闆的屍體弄失，原來老闆未死，被包租的英妹救了。老闆將歌廳交予英打理，並讓眾人於歌廳工作。
術士領著一群行屍進城，宋丹萍混於其中，要找軍閥閻將軍報仇，機緣巧合下救了革命志士黃強。原來昔日萍與歌妓花鳳仙相戀，閻因迷戀仙而謀害萍，萍容顏被毁，仙則自殺。萍與革命志士合作，潛入閰府，與閰同歸於盡。
明末亂世，華雲表得獨臂神尼相助，救回被金吊兒擄走的文鳳子，又知悉八八道士率領的十五門派與滿人勾結。表、鳳等在他們起事之日，將十五門派瓦解。時清兵入關，尼感凋零國事難挽，著表等暫隱居，靜待時機滅清復明。

狐精靈仙塵緣未了，遇上書生周信，與他有夙世姻緣，藉故結織。信對靈仙心生傾慕，老僕忠伯察覺有異，驚悉靈仙為狐精，遂求天庇佑周家，得呂祖下凡幫忙，將靈仙壓於靈塔下，並要靈仙潛心修道，靈仙只好與信不捨泣別。
盲人算命師吳保當年被狀師關澤誣告而入獄，懷恨在心，他伺機戲弄其子仁樹。樹偶然認識保的女兒美珠，互生情愫，卻不知對方身份，因而報復作弄保。保得悉樹、珠相戀，拒絕二人婚事。樹惟有達成保的願望，才得美人歸。
梁人傑的二叔安排他與素未謀面的王秋萍結婚，傑為逃避她而離家。萍追至報館，誤會總編輯程小青是傑，對他纏擾。傑假扮乞丐賣唱避開萍，卻偶遇萍並收留了他，傑對萍暗生情愫。二叔尋至，傑身分曝光，終與萍結為一對。
王家偉偶然看見方韻琴唱歌，對她產生好感，可是兩家父母素有嫌隙，關係勢成水火，更禁止偉與琴交往。偉、琴遂假裝自殺殉情，雙方父母深感後悔，偉、琴隨即「復活」過來，並說出真相，兩家前嫌盡棄，有情人終成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_tc: 紮腳十三妹大鬧能仁寺
epg.programme_title_en: It Happened at Nan Yan Monastery
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 何玉鳳獲義士鄧九公收為義女，並賜名十三妹。妹偶遇安驥，得悉他義助張金鳳葬母及其父被奸相所害，決助他救父。惜驥不辭而別，更分別與金鳳遭能仁寺惡僧禁錮，幸妹與禇一官相救。玉派官護送驥上京，並撮合驥和金鳳。
窮畫家江楓應徵古家女婿，誤以為女僕阿玲是古小姐，心生愛慕。楓詐死騙畫商高價收購畫作，古小姐以為楓已死，嫁予李進財。玲得悉楓未死，答應其求婚。婚禮上財妻尋至，財富貴夢碎；僕人阿福代替財，兩對新人成眷屬。
顏秋鳳無力償還欠債，得凌子健幫忙，兩人墮入愛河，更瞞著健父成親。健之表妹邱淑芬向健父告狀，健被騙回鄉軟禁，與鳳失去聯繫。鳳誕下兒子，派人找健，卻被告知健已死。健父要鳳脫離凌家，鳳不允，芬派人偷走其子。
金展才回鄉，路上偶遇烏大龍，龍見才一介文弱書生模樣，決定護他上路，殊不知才武功高強。獨狼山寨主強娶民女，才假扮新娘，與龍及其妹、表弟大鬧獨狼山。後龍等人與官府合作攻打獨狼山，才暗中幫忙，把獨狼山掃平。
富家女黃玲在挑選丈夫晚會上，選中賣花的林明。李興與陳玉相戀，玉父嫌興家貧，唯玉珠胎暗結。玉產子，興向明借錢急用，遭玲拒。明施計要興男扮女裝騙玲金錢以解興困。玉至黃家找興，興扮女子真相大白，玲與明和好。

epg.programme_title_tc: 紮腳十三妹大鬧能仁寺
epg.programme_title_en: It Happened at Nan Yan Monastery
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 何玉鳳獲義士鄧九公收為義女，並賜名十三妹。妹偶遇安驥，得悉他義助張金鳳葬母及其父被奸相所害，決助他救父。惜驥不辭而別，更分別與金鳳遭能仁寺惡僧禁錮，幸妹與禇一官相救。玉派官護送驥上京，並撮合驥和金鳳。
顏秋鳳無力償還欠債，得凌子健幫忙，兩人墮入愛河，更瞞著健父成親。健之表妹邱淑芬向健父告狀，健被騙回鄉軟禁，與鳳失去聯繫。鳳誕下兒子，派人找健，卻被告知健已死。健父要鳳脫離凌家，鳳不允，芬派人偷走其子。
金展才回鄉，路上偶遇烏大龍，龍見才一介文弱書生模樣，決定護他上路，殊不知才武功高強。獨狼山寨主強娶民女，才假扮新娘，與龍及其妹、表弟大鬧獨狼山。後龍等人與官府合作攻打獨狼山，才暗中幫忙，把獨狼山掃平。
窮畫家江楓應徵古家女婿，誤以為女僕阿玲是古小姐，心生愛慕。楓詐死騙畫商高價收購畫作，古小姐以為楓已死，嫁予李進財。玲得悉楓未死，答應其求婚。婚禮上財妻尋至，財富貴夢碎；僕人阿福代替財，兩對新人成眷屬。

epg.programme_title_tc: 紮腳十三妹大鬧能仁寺
epg.programme_title_en: It Happened at Nan Yan Monastery
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 何玉鳳獲義士鄧九公收為義女，並賜名十三妹。妹偶遇安驥，得悉他義助張金鳳葬母及其父被奸相所害，決助他救父。惜驥不辭而別，更分別與金鳳遭能仁寺惡僧禁錮，幸妹與禇一官相救。玉派官護送驥上京，並撮合驥和金鳳。
蕭永倫與倫碧容指腹為婚，皇上賜玉葵寶扇作信物。蕭家家道中落，容父欲悔婚，永倫不允。永倫赴京考取功名，容贈予金釵，卻被容父誣告為盜賊。梅知府父女不忍陷害無辜，救出永倫。永倫高中而回，與容、梅女結成夫婦。
紂王無道，通天教助紂為虐，哪吒和二郎神楊戩下凡，發現妖道奪魄勾魂來煉誅仙陣。哪吒無法破解誅仙陣，與楊戩扮作金花、銀葉混於商營，欲尋破解方法，惜不果，反遭教主暗算。哪吒唯有請祖師爺相助，終成功誅妖除魔。
畢均與歌女李小娟兩情相悅，兩人欲為托兒所籌款，均施計騙父，騙得金錢以作義演，因此遭父逐出家門。均母惦念兒子，均父遂懸賞尋子，均為領賞再次騙父，又託辭要與娟結婚，希望為托兒所籌足經費，結果弄出重重誤會。
（續上集）顏秋鳳為兒子脫離凌家；凌子健假意娶邱淑芬，於成親日離家尋鳳，與鳳重逢。芬讓鳳作妾，鳳委曲求全，芬竟殺鳳。鳳獲救後扮鬼，芬被嚇至墮樓梯而死。健得知一切後與鳳母子離開，多年後重遇健父，一家團聚。
張韓跟孖七參與走私活動，醉貓昌從中作梗，七遭伏擊死去，其女楊金嬌誤信昌是韓出賣七。昌率眾打韓，黃飛鴻出手相助。韓宴請鴻到妓院，卻遇上昌、嬌，昌從中挑撥，與鴻大打出手，最後妓院失火，昌遇險，鴻仗義營救。

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為瞭解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽鬱香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horrors haunt each family from within, and nothing is really as it seems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,江南某古村接連發生死狀離奇的驚人命案,導致該地淪為方圓百里人人自危的嗜血鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與警員萬楓結伴深入陰森詭異的荒村,在重重迷霧中抽絲剝繭。面對頻頻發生的靈異異象,他們能否徹底揭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模餘虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失憶青年馬可醒來時,驚覺自己被囚禁在一棟廢棄舊屋,四周屍橫遍地。在密閉空間內,他被迫按照神秘幕後黑手的指示,逐一播放隨身碟中的十段詭異錄像。隨著致命詛咒接連降臨,他不僅陷入恐怖幻覺,身體更逐漸異變,記..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amnesiac Marco awakens imprisoned in an abandoned house surrounded by corpses. Trapped inside, he is forced by a mysterious mastermind to play ten disturbing videos on a flash drive. As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

As deadly curses unfold, he is plagued by terrifying visions while his body, memory and life slowly unravel. With the countdown to death underway, can he survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called “The Venoms”, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corru

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田,但當方剛的妻子被擄走,他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」,以救回妻子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master’s b

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun’s warlord as a rev

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後,因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖,最後更被判入獄!究竟天生樂觀的他,能否吉人天相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南劍丁夢豪是「天下第一劍」,卻敗於路過的怪和尚。丁履行諾言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修煉期滿返回家鄉後,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他決戰,唯丁欲隱居民間,所以堅拒一切挑戰。無奈後來卻要被逼與北劍再來一場生死決鬥,究竟最後會是鹿死誰手?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unw

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是少林三部作的第二部,講述劉家輝飾演的周仁傑一心要去少林寺學功夫,最後竟扮成寺中的三德和尚,並創出「搭棚式」的少林武藝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of ‘scaffolding kung fu”.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 良才見秋容貌美,心懷不軌,竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑,相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後,良才音訊全無,秋容更發現自已懷有身孕,於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻,更打算將秋容滅口…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs cl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克里斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末。起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬——直到令人不安的真相浮出水面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事以動盪不安的當代芝加哥為背景,四個毫無共同點的女人,唯一的交集是她們已故丈夫因犯罪活動而留下的債務。她們決定掌握自己的命運,共同謀劃依據自己的方式開創未來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貪腐富豪殺害犯罪目擊者,唯一證人是一名與中國政府有關係的商人之女友。北京保鑣協助香港警方保護她,卻在過程中與證人產生情愫,令任務更加複雜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一名黑人父親藉由殺死襲擊者來為遭到殘暴傷害的女兒報仇後,一位年輕律師必須在一個因種族緊張局勢和三K黨而陷入深度分裂的密西西比州小鎮上為他進行辯護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Black father avenges his daughters brutal assault by killing her attackers, a young lawyer must defend him in a small Mississippi town deeply divided by racial tension and the Ku Klux Klan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 昆汀・塔倫提諾第八部作品,背景設定於寒冷的懷俄明州,八名陌生人——包括兩名賞金獵人與一名通緝犯——在暴風雪中被迫聚在一起,對抗天候,也彼此對立。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dominic Toretto and crew face a deadly new enemy—Deckard Shaw—seeking revenge in this high-octane chapter of the Fast  Furious saga. Action explodes as the team fights to protect their own.

         影片主要講述了江湖大俠李禦風因為厭倦了官場紛爭,與李世民辭行打算返鄉歸隱。不料長安城附近忽然紛傳有女妖挖取人心練功,一時間無論民間還是江湖都..

epg.programme_title_en: The First People’s City Founded by the Chinese Communist

本片講述了鄂倫春族部落首領蓋山和東北抗聯將領王大虎與日本侵略者的鬥爭中結下深厚革命友誼,義結金蘭。並帶領鄂倫春族人在大興安嶺一帶協助抗聯共同抗擊日本侵略者的故事。

李小果和餘朵朵回老家舉行盛大的婚禮,婚宴後,正當大家觀賞他的電影處女作時,山上傳來了守林人報信的槍聲。秋葉幫著護林人樹根將偷樹賊抓住,卻得知小果是主謀。原來小果因為拍戲,欠下一大筆錢,為了還債出此下策。

epg.programme_title_en: The 5th Action Group Ⅲ— Nights of Paris
epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
由於第五行動組的電臺遭到敵人破壞,楊勵和秋婷手中所掌握的敵人的資料無法送出。楊勵打聽到有艘法租界的船近日要離開上海,便找到當初曾幫他買過法租界通行證的小夥計,兩人相約晚上“夜巴黎見面。
可是,楊勵沒有想到真正的賣家即“夜巴黎的女主人竟然..
描寫抗日戰爭中晉察冀地區發生的著名的八路軍五壯士奮勇抗敵,最後彈盡路絕的時候在狼牙山跳崖殉國的壯烈故事。
該片以1940年初侵華日軍重兵偷襲八路軍前線總指揮部的危急時刻,時任八路軍三八六旅參謀長周希漢抗命救駕的史實及一段情緣為依據,真誠的展現了大智大勇、敢作敢為、鐵骨柔腸的一代戰將周希漢——中國的巴頓。

一個男人與豬的奇緣 ,一段令人啼笑皆非卻溫馨至腹的故事。
隨著改革開放的逐步深入,大批湧入城市打工的農民工們經過多年在外艱辛的打拼,有的成家立業,有的已經深深的融入了城市的生活。隨著近年來城鄉差距的日益縮小,在外多年的遊子們紛紛萌發了回鄉創..
柳非春和龍重九一邊遊歷一邊吃好吃的,聽說要舉辦武林盟主大會的比武,柳非春和龍重九來到了舉辦大會地點藏劍山莊,拜訪了龍重九的好友令狐羽莊主。龍重九發現令狐莊主中了噬功散的奇毒,在調查中發現,江湖上三大高手,除了崆峒派掌門唐無影外,中原大俠展夢..
講述了明朝末年,錦衣衛搶奪少林信物木棉袈裟、掌管少林的狂妄企圖,被少林武當聯手回擊,合力剷除的故事。
1938年6月,陳毅率領新四軍在茅山地區建立革命根據地,開展抗日鬥爭。正當大家歡慶衛崗伏擊戰的勝利時,司令部徐參謀遇害。三營長誤以為是國民黨三區樊區長所為,正欲將其處決,陳毅及時趕到,親自為其鬆綁,樊區長大受感動。
歐陽策接到哥哥的密函,趕去與哥哥歐陽召見面,竟然看到哥哥莫名其妙的慘死在自己面前,他為調查哥哥死因,聯合六扇門捕快,剝開迷霧,最終將真凶們一網打盡。
1947年劉、鄧大軍過黃河後,通過黃泛區,強渡汝河,戰勝重重困難,勝利到達大別山區,揭開戰略大反攻的序幕。
嘯西風雙親被害身亡,從此一蹶不振,整日借酒消愁。妻子月蓉帶著女兒九兒嫁給了鐵匠鋪掌櫃吳用。但不料月蓉和九兒被綁架,嘯西風重振精神與昔日的仇敵再度較量,最終救出妻女重新成為一名捕快。
十年不見妻子笑笑的秦奮在老範幫助下得到了一個智慧人笑笑。與假笑笑的相處中秦奮逐漸產生了模糊的感情,而這時候真笑笑回到了他的身邊,兩個笑笑對秦奮互不示弱的爭搶讓秦奮苦不堪言的同時鬧出了一連串的笑話。
民國偵破故事,趙探現場勘察遇到剛回國的劉女探,兩人協力破解槍案。

epg.programme_title_tc: 刑警張玉貴的隊長生活
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 刑警隊長張玉貴為避嫌,向上級請求把妻子付明明調到別的派出所工作,付明明不幹,二人有了摩擦,恰在這時,隊裡接手了一個殺人案。殺人嫌疑犯竟然是被殺者的丈夫,經偵查,證據幾乎屬實並結案,但張玉貴卻感到有些問題不妥,付明明理解張玉貴並全力幫助他偵破..
講述的是一段十九世紀初期發生在中國的一件涉及國寶被盜的故事。
講述的是一段十九世紀初期發生在中國的一件涉及國寶被盜的故事。
從日本留學歸來的陳望道接下了翻譯《共產黨宣言》的任務,從此改變了人生軌跡;陳獨秀、俞秀松、施存統、蔡慕暉等歷史人物一一出場。歷經時代動盪變革,朋友或犧牲或離去,陳望道面臨生死抉擇的考驗。
一九三五年初,當日本帝國主義侵佔華北,民族矛盾集聚上升之時,中國共產黨領導的紅軍被國民黨蔣介石幾十萬軍隊的圍追堵截。 遵義會議過後,黨中央北上土城,準備從宜賓渡過長江的時候,一場遭遇戰,令中央紅軍陷入困境。這是毛澤東回到黨中央領導地位後指揮..
在城裡打工多年的金大發突然回村宣佈要跟妻子李桂鳳離婚。這消息導致金家雞犬不寧。女兒月月上學路上摔落山坡後拒絕開口說話,並且從此跟上了村主任朱一來,李桂鳳天天坐院子裡磨刀,父親金乃貴嚇得賴進朱一來家不走了,李桂飛更是逼著朱一來進城把姐夫找回來..
元朝末年,各地義軍並起,形成割據之局,為鎮壓起義軍,河南王擴闊帖木兒奉命尋找南宋留下的一處龍脈,在尋寶途中與龍門派丘處機、少年時期的張三豐展開的一場驚心動魄的末世英雄傳。
八仙過海的傳說是中國古代最動人的傳說之一,現在已經成為人們經常使用的成語和典故。該片描寫八位神仙人物好打抱不平,懲惡揚善的故事。
跳水夢,講述中國跳水運動員在追逐夢想道路上所經歷的困惑、矛盾和思考,以個人為切入點,以兩個不同時代出生的年輕運動員為代表,探討競技運動中個人和集體、個人和榮譽之間的關係。
程路,一個剛畢業的男大學生,在踏上慢火車的乘務員崗位後,起初,他對這份工作充滿了不屑與抵觸。然而,隨著時間推移,他漸漸在這份平凡的工作中找到了自我,在慢車乘務員這個崗位上,實現了自己的人生價值。
描寫被漢奸惡霸金百萬殺害雙親的大牛和小芳兄妹,失散十餘年後,最後終於在戰場上重逢相認的故事。

表現偉大的戰士雷鋒的主要模範事蹟。

    影片描寫了偉大的共產主義戰士雷鋒的英雄事蹟。    雷鋒應一個小學的邀請做了少先隊員們的課外輔導員,為了讓少先隊員們真正認識到舊社會的黑暗,珍惜今天的美好生活,雷鋒便將自己童年的悲慘遭遇講給..

紅衣人的出現迫使陳立威孤身飛抵雲海市,以灰狼老闆的身份,用名貴中..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《周恩來》以總理一生最後的十年的奮鬥歷程為主線,真實地再現了總理生前“鞠躬盡瘁,死而後己,日理萬機的生活圖景。本片以大量的時空交叉,現實與閃回,回憶並敘的手法不斷觀照他一生的主要革命經歷。反映出總理作為革命者、思想家所具有的崇高的無私奉獻..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雨藍和小妹回鄉 途中被越獄的蘇猛等人劫持, 小妹被殺害,雨藍被義匪唐斬 所救,執意在 屠門鎮 尋找高手 為妹妹追凶報仇。在革離、唐 斬的幫助下,最終追上蘇猛等 人,挫敗了其炸毀鐵路火車的 瘋狂舉動,重新將蘇猛繩之以 法。
孔小雯懷著三個月的孕被人殺死在竹林。小雯的妹妹小倩講,這個孩子是小雯和季哥的,之所以一開始沒講是怕小雯的男朋友薛進中知道。員警根據小倩提供的資訊,抓到了那個叫季哥的人。但是季哥那天晚上一直在洗腳房,沒有作案時間。小雯的男朋友薛建中調查得知殺..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A 3 monthes pregnanted woman, Kong Xiaowen, is killed in a bamboo grove. As per what Xiaowen’s younger sister, Xiao Qian says, the baby is not her current boyfriend, Xue Jinzhong’s, but Xiaowen’s brother Ji. After investigation, policemen capture brother

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手,被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺,為了復仇加入羲和堂,在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇,在生死槍戰之際卻發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary sniper Ghost Hand is hunted by the Yi He gang that is responsible for safeguarding the city. Lu Lan joins the gang to take revenge on Ghost Hand who has killed his brother. After training to become a top sniper, Lu Lan uncovers the true identity of Ghost Hand during a shootout and uncovers the conspiracy of Yi He gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 捉妖師林天師的徒弟劉一澤,向心上人丁香提親之時,發現丁家被狐妖所控制。與狐妖鬥法後,劉誤以為狐妖已被師傅封印,不幸發現狐妖已附身在師傅身上。劉一方面要對付狐妖,另一方面又怕傷害師傅。他最終能否戰勝狐妖..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exorcist Liu Yi Ze proposes marriage to his girlfriend, but discovers that her family is manipulated by the Fox Demon. During his fight with the Fox Demon who has possessed his masters body, Liu Yi Ze must defeat the Fox Demon without hurting his master. Can he vanquish the demon and safeguard everyone?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

Noting the serious corruption in the force, Xu seeks to become the most powerful inspector to eradicate corruption. Though his friend heads a triad gang, Xu still joins forces with the ICAC to provide evidence against the culprits to make them pay the price of their crimes.

Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風光旖旎的海島度假酒店遭遇突如其來的海嘯襲擊,與海嘯一起肆虐而來的是一條生猛的巨鯊。曾經作為潛水人員的王磊與朋友Lisa陷入絕境,與他們一同被困的還有與丈夫前來度蜜月的小琳以及蠻橫無理的富家少爺桑尼。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A beautiful island resort is devastated by an unexpected tsunami, and the attack of a fierce shark soon follows. A former diver, his friend Lisa, a newlywed couple and a rich young man are trapped on the island. A deadly fight between humans and the shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高尚是一名普通的救護車司機,從小就懷抱著賽車夢想。他誤打誤撞捲入一場飆車糾紛中,結識了一流賽車機械師鮑佳音,令他有機會開啓賽車手之路。在他猶疑不知應該選擇安穩生活還是賽車夢想之際,好友的萌萌激勵讓他領..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大法醫宋慈系列之偷梁換柱
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋慈在建甯縣遇到知縣大人誤判吳蜚卿案,為了幫助吳洗脫冤屈找出真相,宋必須在兩天之內抓住真凶。根據紙扇上的神秘痕跡、消失不見的兇器、宋在面對種種疑點,終於找出了與兇手有關的蛛絲馬跡。此時,突然出現的一份..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真無邪的少女清澄,為了給家人報仇,被訓練成冷血殺手。數度殺人後,她決定放下怨念,在安樂寨度過平靜的餘生,也在那裡結識了樂於助人的阿邦,與他結了婚。正當清澄隱藏武功平淡過活時,江湖風雲無奈又起。為了維..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mystic Nine: Qing Shan Hai
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世代盤踞東北的神秘張家後人張啟山,身負國仇家恨初到長沙,與身懷絕技的少班主二月紅相遇。兩位少年英雄惺惺相惜,攜手力撼軍閥勢力,共同對抗盤踞長沙無惡不作的軍閥左謙之,還揭開傳聞的“怪物真相,一同守護長..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴,邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務,為了掩護隊友撤退,美獨自引爆炸彈,與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架,迫雅美..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
