epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集會看一些世上最大的昆蟲.蟬形齒指蝦蛄被獵食者威嚇時,會打開翅膀,展露代表警告的色彩和圖案.巨型非洲百足是溫和的草食性動物,但不代表能欺負牠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crawl along with some of the worlds fiercest insects. Watch as giant cockroaches build their immune systems to ensure long life. Then check out the toxic prowess of giant millipedes and the invisibility cloaks of giant prickly stick insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視野對生存尤關重要.這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法.眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無間的生死大戰中,動物已經進化出各種各樣的顏色,圖案和形狀,幫助它們捕獵,隱藏和保護自己.我們在本集解釋了一些最有趣的偽裝和變色能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道,河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們一起瞭解這三個族群吧:在鬱鬱蔥蔥的中心地帶活動的大型曼茲族群,荒地的卡庫裡族群,以及生活在公園邊緣的小型鸛群.聆聽朱爾茲講述它們在這個成敗攸關的賽季中的勝利和失敗事蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with the three packs: the large Manzi pack in the lush heartland, the Kakuli pack in the Badlands, and the tiny Stork Colony pack living at the parks edge. Follow Julz as he shares their victories and defeats in this make-or-break season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器,枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體,以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒.猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會.我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加的夏天以令人驚嘆的高動態範圍成像方法拍攝,展現了美國最北部州份充滿活力的雄偉景緻.從令人驚嘆的小灣,海灣和水灣所展示巴拉諾夫島的崎嶇之美,到座頭鯨和虎鯨在參天的冰川和高聳的山脈間那平靜的水域中暢遊的冰川灣,這是阿拉斯加與眾不同的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to Augus...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的荒野是一個難以生存的地方.這裡許多動物都必須成群結隊來幫忙保衛領土,保護後代,覓食和對抗掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哥倫比亞中心的熱帶雨林中長大,一隻年輕的捲尾猴必須掌握牠的攀爬技巧,學習如何尋找食物,又要學會區分敵友.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒.猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會.我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 氣溫上升意味著水越來越少,並使得大地充滿炎熱感.曼茲族群必須與捕食性動物比鄰而立,依靠剩餘的珍貴水域補充水分.與維卡群一起狩獵,餵養幼崽,並觀察鶴群如何在各種困難中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Wekas pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒.猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會.我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to Augus...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每天在盧安瓜谷都會看到一具動物屍體.每一具都擁有導致牠們死亡的故事.在草原狩獵鑑證科中,我們調查已發現的3具屍體的死亡個案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞的卡桑卡國家公園是一個不尋常狒狒種類的家園.狒狒有點背棄了通常與這些大型猴子相關的主導地位的攻擊性,並開展更和平的生活.與牠們生活的是一支專門的研究團隊,他們的任務是揭示這些狒狒的秘密,並瞭解是什麼讓牠們變成這樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Colombias high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒.猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會.我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加的夏天以令人驚嘆的高動態範圍成像方法拍攝,展現了美國最北部州份充滿活力的雄偉景緻.從令人驚嘆的小灣,海灣和水灣所展示巴拉諾夫島的崎嶇之美,到座頭鯨和虎鯨在參天的冰川和高聳的山脈間那平靜的水域中暢遊的冰川灣,這是阿拉斯加與眾不同的旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to Augus...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人.和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達回到救援中心搶救纏在偷獵者鐵絲網中的一頭小象,阿爾瑪嘗試讓初到貴境又可愛至極綽號「手繪波波」的狒狒嬰兒與狒狒養母建立關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poachers snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達為在馬拉威二十年來出生的首批獵豹幼崽的其中一隻戴上無線電頸圈;團隊努力給一條4米長的蟒蛇一個身體檢查;一群遊客則送來一隻從寵物販賣中救出來的暴躁猴子嬰兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尚比亞擁有三個非常特殊和不同的非洲伊甸園.位於低處又炎熱的是盧安瓜河谷,高處又乾旱的是柳瓦平原,而涼爽濕潤的是卡桑卡國家公園.這些特質由它們的所在和季節所塑造,每個地方都為選擇於那定居的野生動物提供獨特的東西.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place of...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哥倫比亞洛斯亞諾斯的扁平稀樹草原受到季節性極端的影響,將生命推向絕境.在這個無情的舞台上,沒有第二次機會,只有最適應殘酷極端的生物才能度過一年.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達回到救援中心搶救纏在偷獵者鐵絲網中的一頭小象,阿爾瑪嘗試讓初到貴境又可愛至極綽號「手繪波波」的狒狒嬰兒與狒狒養母建立關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poachers snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達為在馬拉威二十年來出生的首批獵豹幼崽的其中一隻戴上無線電頸圈;團隊努力給一條4米長的蟒蛇一個身體檢查;一群遊客則送來一隻從寵物販賣中救出來的暴躁猴子嬰兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從百老匯舞臺到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華,最全能的表演者之一.這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉金鋼狼一角名揚全球的星路歷程.透過舞臺上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員,歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Broadway to blockbuster, Hugh Jackman is one of the most versatile performers of his generation. This documentary traces his journey from humble Australian beginnings to global stardom as Wolverine. Through stage triumphs and personal challenges

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從百老匯舞臺到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華,最全能的表演者之一.這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉金鋼狼一角名揚全球的星路歷程.透過舞臺上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員,歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生--從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係,與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖,最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston - from her gospel roots to global superstardom - unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看50年代的廣告活動如何推出新的美國傳統和明天會更好的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how ad campaigns from the 50s launched new American traditions and the promise of a bright tomorrow.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 審視60年代的廣告男女,以及他們如何用智慧和嘲諷來接觸新受眾,因而改革整個產業.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine 60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The city rich in history and hearty food surprises with elevated live-fire cooking, fresh Capalachi pasta and an unexpected turn on the classic Philly Cheesesteak. Mena learns to make delectable donuts with funnyman Maz Jobrani and crushes an absol

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿到訪一個充滿傳統⋯⋯和肉汁的城市,他品嚐了豐盛的素魁北克經典美食-蓋澆薯條,煙燻肉三文治,加拿大肉餡餅和著名的蒙特婁貝果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked meat sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在紐奧良與食物歷史學家璽拉爬瑪和食譜作家添麥菲帕鋼一起探索一系列迷人的路易斯安素食名產--素貝涅餅,秋葵濃湯,餅乾和窮鬼三明治.作為餐前後酒,他在紐奧良這座大城市中心一邊品酒一邊上雞尾酒調製的一課.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Big Easy, Mena explores a charming host of plant-based Louisiana staples-vegan beignets, gumbo, biscuits and po boys-with food historian Zella Palmer and cookbook author Timothy Pakron. As an aperitif, he sips his way through a lesson in cockt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯.他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena feasts with magician and Vegas legend Penn Jillette. He explores the off-strip Sin City vegan food scene, indulging in plant-based Beef Wellington, sky-high waffles, and intricate dim sum, then dines with cookbook author Carleigh Bodrug.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果.他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #3
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s luxury train tour continues with cabin views, Culloden’s history, seal-spotting in Plockton, cattle droving tales, train driving, whisky tasting, eagle spotting, and countryside yoga bliss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 審視60年代的廣告男女,以及他們如何用智慧和嘲諷來接觸新受眾,因而改革整個產業.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine 60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看更嚴格的規則和公眾的不信任如何啟發70年代的廣告商創造一些史上最偉大的廣告活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how stricter rules and public mistrust inspired 1970s advertisers to create some of historys greatest campaigns.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看廣告商如何利用新的樂觀主義和新科技在貪婪是美德時代裡大賣產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the Greed is Good era.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一種由鋼和鈦製成的獨特巨型運輸工具,有著一個特殊用途:提煉數噸黃金.這款所謂的滅菌釜是同類之最.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A unique mega transport made of steel and titanium with a special purpose: to extract tons of gold. This so-called autoclave is the biggest of its kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主持人米克大衛臣前往智利偏遠的阿塔卡馬沙漠,到訪地球上最令人難以置信,最複雜的天文臺之一- ALMA.他與ALMA的專家團一起修復一些世上最大的天線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Host Mike Davidson goes to the remote Atacama desert in Chile and to one of the most incredible and complex observatories on Earth - ALMA. He works alongside ALMAs expert team as they repair some of the worlds biggest antennas.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球疫情導致世上唯一的水底棲息地停運.米克大衛臣加入裂縫修復小組,一同潛入水中修復它,並讓美國太空總署的太空人返回內部進行訓練.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide pandemic ceased operations on the worlds only underwater habitat. Mike Davidson joins a crack repair crew as they dive in to bring it back to life and get NASA astronauts back inside for training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險,叢林健行,極致享受的巧克力按摩,蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Saint Lucia, the twins crash Maisie’s getaway for a whirlwind of sailing adventures, jungle hikes, decadent chocolate massages, rum tastings, and endless tropical fun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險--賞鯨,火山健行,策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape-whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險,水上飛行器,揮桿高爾夫,快艇狂飆--最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races-then shares Potter memories over dinner...the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:徵服壯麗塔特拉山,漂流急湍河道,探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena feasts with magician and Vegas legend Penn Jillette. He explores the off-strip Sin City vegan food scene, indulging in plant-based Beef Wellington, sky-high waffles, and intricate dim sum, then dines with cookbook author Carleigh Bodrug.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom-plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to talk to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bathed in sunshine and Big Latin Culture, Mena learns to make classic Cubanos and traditional Puerto Rican mofongo-vegan-style. He cruises the seas with cookbook author Radhi Devlukia, takes actor Matt Murray to South Beach for mouth-watering molten

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
epg.programme_title_en: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性,有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合天命真女主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

epg.programme_title_en: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jackson’s status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the Greed is Good era.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反.在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓.對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer is the season of plenty for most animals, but not polar bears; unable to hunt seals until the sea freezes over again, they grow hungrier by the day; for other animals summer is when youngsters must learn how to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

epg.programme_title_en: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jackson’s status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

epg.programme_title_en: Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. 『The Way of the Warrior』 takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.programme_title_tc: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努與加德拜訪提姆.艾利斯--這位年輕執行長是相對論太空公司的創辦人,該公司打造並發射了全球第一枚3D列印火箭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world’s first 3D printed rocket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夜間追蹤任務到救援行動,了解MH-6小鳥直昇機如何在其他大型機體中贏得一席之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From night stalker missions to rescue operations, see how the Little Bird helicopter earned its place among the big boys.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the story of Shakira, the Columbian born superstar who has sold over 100 million records; covering her unwavering advocacy and philanthropic efforts that make her a role model for aspiring artists and fans alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索年輕的諾瑪珍.在展現才華和膽色的同時,她拋開艱辛的童年,以瑪麗蓮夢露的身份進入好萊塢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as 『Marilyn Monroe』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探討瑪麗蓮如何反對裸體,以及她怎樣一躍成星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從百老匯舞臺到好萊塢巨片,休·傑克曼(Hugh Jackman)是他那代最具才華,最全能的表演者之一.這部紀錄片追溯了他從澳洲的平凡起點,到憑藉金鋼狼一角名揚全球的星路歷程.透過舞臺上的輝煌成就與個人的重重挑戰,我們將揭開這些角色背後,那位全心投入的演員,歌手以及人道主義者的真實面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Broadway to blockbuster, Hugh Jackman is one of the most versatile performers of his generation. This documentary traces his journey from humble Australian beginnings to global stardom as Wolverine. Through stage triumphs and personal challenges

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.programme_title_tc: 揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋
epg.programme_title_en: Barbie Uncovered: A Dream House Divided
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《揭秘芭比:分裂的夢幻屋》揭示創作芭比娃娃背後的戲劇性真實故事,重點講述聯合創作者羅絲韓德勒和傑克瑞恩的高山與低谷,以及他們標誌性又備受爭議發明的持久影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie Uncovered reveals the dramatic true story behind Barbie’s creation, spotlighting the rise and fallout of co-creators Ruth Handler and Jack Ryan, and the lasting impact of their iconic, controversial invention.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生--從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係,與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖,最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston - from her gospel roots to global superstardom - unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮決心成為認真的演員,以及她離開二十世紀霍士創辦自己的製作公司.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how Marilyn shows her mature talent as an actress and wins a triumphant victory over Twentieth Century Fox shortly before her untimely death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as 『America’s Nice Guy』, 』The Everyman』 and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It takes patience and commitment for The Rhino Orphanage, as they nurture young rhinos whose mothers have been lost to poaching.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然.三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們.四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看廣告商如何利用新的樂觀主義和新科技在貪婪是美德時代裡大賣產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the Greed is Good era.

epg.programme_title_en: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片.歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光.從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在紐奧良與食物歷史學家璽拉爬瑪和食譜作家添麥菲帕鋼一起探索一系列迷人的路易斯安素食名產--素貝涅餅,秋葵濃湯,餅乾和窮鬼三明治.作為餐前後酒,他在紐奧良這座大城市中心一邊品酒一邊上雞尾酒調製的一課.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Big Easy, Mena explores a charming host of plant-based Louisiana staples-vegan beignets, gumbo, biscuits and po boys-with food historian Zella Palmer and cookbook author Timothy Pakron. As an aperitif, he sips his way through a lesson in cockt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯.他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena feasts with magician and Vegas legend Penn Jillette. He explores the off-strip Sin City vegan food scene, indulging in plant-based 「Beef」 Wellington, sky-high waffles, and intricate dim sum, then dines with cookbook author Carleigh Bodrug.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果.他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bathed in sunshine and Big Latin Culture, Mena learns to make classic Cubanos and traditional Puerto Rican mofongo-vegan-style. He cruises the seas with cookbook author Radhi Devlukia, takes actor Matt Murray to South Beach for mouth-watering molten

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵.他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月,多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費裡曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費裡曼的人生旅程--從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman-his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked 「meat」 sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dr. Matt gets to play matchmaker when three fallow deer trade their bachelor days for life with a 120-strong female deer herd. But first Matt must dart the deer and remove their antlers -V so the pressure's really on.  The abandoned baby badger has trebled in size, but back in the surgery, a tiny water dragon is in for a tricky operation.  There's good news for two rescued stray cats when they find a luxury new home - and at Flamingoland, Matt lets the ring-tailed lemurs out into their brand new enclosure after a winter spent indoors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From the jungle to the ocean, predators like tigers, crocodiles, and sharks use lethal tools—teeth and claws—to dominate their prey. Nature’s arsenal is unmatched.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans. This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troubles.Real people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life.
From money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores. In 2015, David Dungay Jr., an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody. The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year. Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents. “When I see black America, I see part of myself. When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not.” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message. “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists. Because it is there. Because it can touch my life at any time.”

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like.  Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme.  There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells.  A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole.  Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security.  Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners. So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally.  Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release.  For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold. Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

epg.programme_title_tc: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.programme_title_en: Inside Facebook - Secrets of A Social Network
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Banning its news feature in Australia, Facebook draws international condemnation. But how does the social media giant regulate its content, in an era marked by insidious fake news? This alarming documentary offers unique undercover access to Facebook’s moderating hub. It presents a disturbing picture of an organisation putting money before morality and for whom extreme content equals extreme profits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights. Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement. Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces.
